description: This file defines the build configuration, dependencies, variables, and build steps for the Boost libraries within a Yocto/OpenEmbedded build system. It includes package definitions, compilation and installation procedures, and configuration for various Boost components.

methods.name: do_configure
methods.description: Configures the Boost build system, setting compiler flags, toolchain, and optional Python/ MPI support before building.

methods.name: do_compile
methods.description: Runs the Boost build command (b2) with configured options to compile the libraries.

methods.name: do_install
methods.description: Installs the compiled Boost libraries and creates necessary symbolic links and configuration files post-build.

calls: for lib in ${BOOST_LIBS}; do if [ -e ${D}${libdir}/libboost_${lib}.a ]; then ln -s libboost_${lib}.a ${D}${libdir}/libboost_${lib}-mt.a; fi; if [ -e ${D}${libdir}/libboost_${lib}.so ]; then ln -s libboost_${lib}.so ${D}${libdir}/libboost_${lib}-mt.so; fi; done
